title: Zesty Creamy Venezuelan Pasta
description: A floral and creamy Venezuelan dish featuring paccheri pasta, this recipe is a comforting and Whole30-friendly option for a weeknight dinner. The flambe technique adds a nice caramelized flavor to the dish.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the paccheri pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt the ghee over medium heat and add the sliced onion, cooking until caramelized and golden brown.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the rum to the skillet and flambe the mixture, cooking until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Stir in the coconut cream, chopped cilantro, lime juice, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes, until thickened and creamy.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
